unruled:ny_city_rs#1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 4, Item A. A joint return with a spouse who was not a full-year New York State and City resident is refused: ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident (federal status mfj and ny_it201.ask.spouse_resident No).

unruled:ny_it2#1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 21, Form IT-2: a W-2c's corrected amounts are not asked for, and the IT-2 record required for foreign income received without a Form W-2 is neither built nor refused. Rare; low.

unruled:ny_rs#1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 4, Item A. As ny_city_rs#1: the mixed-residency joint return is refused by ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident.

unruled:ny_it201#1.evidence: ny_it201i pp. 5-6, Item A, filing status 3: "You are unable to file a joint New York return because: - the address or whereabouts of your spouse is unknown ..." and "your spouse refuses to sign a joint New York return". As the earlier ny_it201#1 ruling: a filer on a joint federal return who must file separately for New York is not asked about and not refused; the New York return follows the federal status. The spouse-residency gate (ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident), now a choice on the filing status, is unchanged in meaning. Rare; low; BUG-0424.

unruled:ny_it201#2.evidence: ny_it201i p. 11, Lines 37 and 38: "If line 36 is more than line 35, leave line 37 and line 38 blank." ny_it201.line37 is subtract_floor0 of line 35 and line 36 (type NonNegDollars), so it is zero, never negative, when the dependent exemptions exceed line 35, and its note reads the blank as zero; line 38 copies it. The claim's negative flow to lines 38, 47 and 69a does not occur. [Restamped unchanged from the ruling of earlier claim #2 under prompt_sha a11c6e21: same form, same quoted text, same cited page, same item and effect.]

unruled:ny_it201#3.evidence: ny_it201i p. 20, Line 69a: "If you ... marked Yes at item C ... you do not qualify to claim this credit." ny_it201.line69a is a choice on ny_it201.item_c: Yes takes ny_it201.zero_stc ($0), No takes the rate reduction amount (ny_it201.stc_rr); its $500,000 refusal gate (ny_it201.gate.stc_rr_income) applies only with item C No. The item C rule the claim says is missing is the line's first guard.

unruled:ny_it201#4.evidence: ny_it201i p. 18, Line 59: "You may not use this line to report: ... any unpaid sales and use tax on motor vehicles, trailers, all-terrain vehicles, vessels, or snowmobiles. This tax is paid directly to the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)." ny_it201.ask.owes_use_tax has no exclusion for tax paid to the DMV, so a filer whose only unpaid use tax is on such a vehicle under $1,000 answers Yes and gets a chart amount on line 59. The business-purchase part of the claim is covered: ny_it201.ask.use_tax_st141 names purchases for a business and is refused (Form ST-141). Low; BUG-0481.
